effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] [When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your [Marcus Damon]s is also treated as a 3000 DP Digimon, can't digivolve, and gains ＜Blocker＞.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When one of your red or yellow Tamers becomes suspended, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP for the turn.
